description_en: Retrieves traffic allocation details for a specific traffic control task

kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice get-traffic-control-task-traffic --traffic-control-task-id 1 --instance-id pairec-test-xxx --environment Pre --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTrafficControlTaskTraffic

parameters.help_en:
The environment. Valid values:

`Daily`: The daily environment.

`Pre`: The staging environment.

`Prod`: The production environment
